status: fixed before the first zkFuzz run on these cases
purpose: Development RQ1 pilot: does running the decomposed pieces find known real bugs that a whole-entrypoint zkFuzz run misses within the same time budget? Every case was used in development, so this is not an independent evaluation.

cases.entrypoint_note: production entrypoint; zkbugs lists generated per-template mains for these two bugs
zkbugs Original Entrypoint for the FpMul case
cases.split_runner_note: zkfDO preparation excludes all four zk-email pieces (library dependencies outside the project root cannot be fingerprinted; log_ceil parameters and compile-time variable arrays are unsupported by inspection), so the pieces are run one at a time by calling zkFuzz directly with the same seeds and limits. random uses a seeded shuffle of the path-sorted pieces and small-first uses compiled constraint counts.

strategy_note: risk-only and cost-aware are left out because the pinned Circomspect cannot analyze templates with anonymous components in inference; each strategy is prepared with only the features it needs
detection: whole: zkFuzz reports NOT SAFE within the budget (attribution to the known bug is checked by hand); split: a counterexample from a piece whose template is a ground-truth template. Split candidates are not reviewed in this pilot.
parallelism: the case-lane combinations run concurrently, one zkFuzz process per lane
pieces: unique concrete instances reachable from the entrypoint whose source file is inside the project tree; library-owned instances (for example circomlib) are not separate pieces and run inside the pieces that use them
